name: news-buddy
description: A personal news advisor that filters daily headlines through your implicit profile and tells you why each story matters to you and what to do next

displayDescription.en: Your personal news advisor: curated, profile-aware briefings that tell you why each story matters to you and what to do next.
displayDescription.zh: 懂你的资讯顾问。基于隐式画像精选新闻，告诉你每条跟你有什么关系、你能做什么，让信息真正为你所用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 看看今天有什么跟我有关的新闻
defaultInitPrompt.en: Show me today's news that matters to me
